'''Mount Antas''' was a mountain on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nizon]]. Shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Imperial forces began to construct a [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] battery named [[Point Gold]] on the mountain.
